secret.description: Flags leaked credentials and hardcoded secrets

high-entropy-string.description: Flags high-entropy string tokens that may be API keys or tokens

old-todo.description: Flags TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX comments older than todoMaxAgeDays

ignorePaths.description: List of relative path glob patterns to ignore from GitSanity scanning

maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum file size in megabytes to scan

entropyThreshold.description: Minimum Shannon entropy score to flag as high-entropy string

entropyMinLength.description: Minimum token length required for Shannon entropy evaluation

envFile.description: Target environment variables file (relative to workspace root)

envExampleFile.description: Target environment variables example file (relative to workspace root)

createEnvExample.description: Whether to also populate the .env.example file when moving secrets to .env

largeFileMB.description: Threshold in megabytes to flag tracked or staged files as large

maxProjectFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan during a whole project scan

blockOnWarnings.description: Whether the pre-commit hook blocks commits when warning-severity issues are found

todoMaxAgeDays.description: Maximum age in days before a TODO comment is flagged by the old-todo rule
